items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1961-01-29
items.q: We had the Rene band that time, I remember at the Bulls, there was Rene on trumpet... I didn't know. We had the Rene band that time

ctx.x: And Rene would play at all those places?
No, not Rene, I mean, that was a different band. Oh, yeah. Rene played at the Bullets at that time, most of the time.
Mm-hmm. Who did Rene have on banjo? Can you remember?
